curation_directives.focus: High-emergence unexpected open-world moments, hilarious NPC anomalies, and comedic failures over routine gameplay.

UNEXPECTED_COLLISION_CHAOS.name: Accidental Chaos & Instant Karma
UNEXPECTED_COLLISION_CHAOS.description: Routine crash turns into an absurd or hilarious chain reaction.
triggers: Car collision triggers secondary explosion (propane, gas pump, tanker)
Hit NPC flies through air into an impossible spot (rooftop, pool, moving truck)
Rear-ended driver gets out holding a rocket launcher or baseball bat
Streamer mocks someone and immediately experiences catastrophic ragdoll karma
learned_user_preferences: Only pick car crashes if there is an unexpected escalation or extreme visual ragdoll.
Routine fender benders without high speed or drama should be discarded.

ROBBERY_AND_SHAKEDOWN_GONE_WRONG.name: Robbery & Rent Collection Gone Wrong
ROBBERY_AND_SHAKEDOWN_GONE_WRONG.description: Attempting to rob a store, collect money, or shakedown an NPC, but an unexpected twist ruins the plan.
triggers: Store clerk secretly pulls combat shotgun or machete from under the counter
Off-duty police officer is standing in the aisle drinking coffee when hold-up starts
Cash register is completely empty or clerk faints on alarm button
Streamer flees store only to find their getaway car was towed or stolen by an NPC
learned_user_preferences: Prioritize clips where Ravi's facecam/voice goes from ultra-confident to pure panic.

ABSURD_NPC_INTERACTIONS.name: Bizarre & Hilarious NPC Anomalies
ABSURD_NPC_INTERACTIONS.description: Unscripted open-world NPC interactions that produce peak comedic or unhinged content.
triggers: Two random NPCs get into a brutal fistfight in the background while player is talking
Pedestrian delivers outrageous Hindi/English voice line right next to player mic
Florida wildlife (alligator, swamp panther) bursts into an urban store or car dealership
Pedestrian casually steals player car while player is buying armor
learned_user_preferences: Prioritize clear voice lines from NPCs over quiet background movement.

AURA_ENTRY_INSTANT_REGRET.name: Aura Walk-In vs. Instant Regret
AURA_ENTRY_INSTANT_REGRET.description: Streamer tries to enter a combat zone with sigma / Bollywood hero aura, ending in instantaneous disaster.
triggers: Slow confident walk through entrance doors interrupted by sniper headshot or shotgun blast
Epic vehicle jump into enemy camp landing upside down inside a dumpster
Challenging an enemy boss with confident trash talk and immediately getting one-tapped
learned_user_preferences: Pacing must be sharp: build up aura for 5-8s, instant comedic cutoff within 1s of failure.

NOOB_MULTI_FAIL_TRIUMPH.name: The Noob Failure Arc
NOOB_MULTI_FAIL_TRIUMPH.description: Failing the same checkpoint 2-4 times with escalating frustration, finally beating it with ecstatic celebration.
triggers: Same mission checkpoint reloaded >= 2 times within 10 minutes
Escalating voice frustration and comedic sighs
learned_user_preferences: Keep each fail cut under 4 seconds in the montage to maintain rapid comedic tempo.
